entries.name: Forced march
entries.description: Marching more than 8 hours per day requires a Con saving throw at DC 10 + 1 per additional hour, at the end of each additional hour. If failed, suffer one level of exhaustion (see conditions).

entries.name: Food
entries.description: Go without food for 3 + Con modifier of consecutive days (1 day minimum). At the end of each day beyond that, suffer one level of exhaustion (see conditions).

entries.name: Water
entries.description: If only half a gallon is consumed, DC 15 Con saving throw at end of day. If failed or consumed less than half, suffer one level of exhaustion, or two levels of exhaustion if currently already exhausted (see conditions).

entries.name: Falling
entries.description: 1d6 bludgeoning damage per 10 feet fallen, to a maximum of 20d6. End prone if taken any damage from the fall.

entries.name: Suffocating
entries.description: Hold breath for 1 + Con modifier in minutes (30 seconds minimum). After that, survive for Con modifier in rounds, after which drop to 0 hit points and dying.

entries.name: Short rest
entries.description: A short rest takes 1 hour of doing nothing too strenuous. At the end of the rest, spend hit dice to regain hit points.

entries.name: Long rest
entries.description: A long rest takes 8 hours with nothing too strenuous for more than 1 hour of that. Regain all hit points and half hit dice at end. If food and water are consumed, reduce exhaustion level by 1. Maximum of 1 long rest per 24 hours.

entries.name: Melee attack
entries.description: Normal attack on target within 5 ft. If attacking with a light melee weapon in one hand, allowed to make an attack with a light melee weapon in other hand as a bonus action, see ‘Two-Weapon Fighting’. If either weapon has the thrown property, it may be thrown as part of this action.

entries.name: Ranged attack
entries.description: Normal attack if up to normal range (first number). Disadvantage on the attack if up to long range (second number). Disadvantage on the attack if a hostile that is not incapacitated is within 5 ft and can see the attacker.

entries.name: Two-weapon fighting
entries.description: If making an attack with a light melee weapon in one hand, allowed to make an attack with a light melee weapon in other hand as a bonus action. This off-hand attack can’t add a positive ability score modifier to the damage roll. If the weapon has the thrown property, it may be thrown as part of this action.

entries.name: Disarm
entries.description: Knock an item from grasp by winning weapon attack roll vs. opponent’s Str (Athletics) or Dex (Acrobatics) check. Disadvantage on the weapon attack roll if the item is being held with two or more hands. Larger opponents have advantage and smaller have disadvantage.

entries.name: Grapple
entries.description: With a free hand, give the grappled condition to an opponent that is within reach and up to one size larger than you by winning Str (Athletics) check vs. opponent’s Str (Athletics) or Dex (Acrobatics) check.

entries.name: Mark
entries.description: With a melee attack you can mark the target of that attack. The next opportunity attack against the marked target before the end of your next turn has advantage and doesn’t cost you your reaction.

entries.name: Shove
entries.description: Move opponent 5 ft or make prone by winning opposing Str (Athletics) check. Disadvantage if trying to move the opponent to a side rather than to directly away from you.

entries.name: Blinded
entries.description: Fail checks involving sight. Attacks have disadvantage. Enemy attacks have advantage.

entries.name: Charmed
entries.description: Can’t harm/attack charmer. Charmer has advantage on ability checks to interact socially.

entries.name: Deafened
entries.description: Fail checks involving hearing.

entries.name: Frightened
entries.description: Disadvantage to checks/attacks while the source of fear is in sight. Can’t willingly move closer to the source of fear.

entries.name: Grappled
entries.description: Speed 0, regardless of bonus. Ends when grappler is incapacitated or when moved out of grappler’s reach by an effect.

entries.name: Incapacitated
entries.description: Can’t take actions or reactions.

entries.name: Invisible
entries.description: Can’t be seen (normally), but still make noise and tracks. Attacks have advantage. Enemy attacks have disadvantage.

entries.name: Paralyzed
entries.description: Incapacitated. Can’t move or speak. Fail Str and Dex saving throws. Enemy attacks have advantage. Enemy attacks within 5 ft are critical hits.

entries.name: Petrified
entries.description: Incapacitated. Can’t move or speak. Unaware of surroundings. Resistance to all damage. Immune to poison / disease. Fail Str and Dex saving throws. Enemy attacks have advantage. Stop aging. Weight increases by factor 10.

entries.name: Poisoned
entries.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

entries.name: Prone
entries.description: Crawl (at ½ speed) or stand up (costs ½ speed). Attacks have disadvantage. Enemy attacks have advantage within 5 ft and disadvantage if further away.

entries.name: Restrained
entries.description: Speed 0, regardless of bonus. Disadvantage on Dex saving throws. Attacks have disadvantage. Enemy attacks have advantage.

entries.name: Stunned
entries.description: Incapacitated. Can’t move. Can speak only falteringly. Fail Str and Dex saving throws. Enemy attacks have advantage.

entries.name: Unconscious
entries.description: Incapacitated. Can’t move or speak. Unaware of surroundings. Drop everything. Fail Str and Dex saving throws. Enemy attacks have advantage. Enemy attacks within 5 ft are critical hits.

degrees.effect: Can’t be targeted directly by attack or spell

entries.name: Blindsight
entries.effect: Out to range, perceive without sight.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries.effect: Out to range, treat dim light as bright light. Can’t see colors.

entries.name: Truesight
entries.effect: Out to range, perceive everything regardless of (magical) darkness, invisibility, illusions, shapechanging, or etherealness.

entries.name: Attack
entries.description: Make one melee or ranged attack with a weapon, or multiple attacks with the ‘Extra Attack’ class feature. (See the ‘Attack Action’ section below.)

entries.name: Cast a spell
entries.description: Effect depends on the spell being cast.

entries.name: Dash
entries.description: Gain your speed as extra movement for this turn.

entries.name: Disengage
entries.description: Your movement doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Dodge
entries.description: Attack rolls from attackers you can see have disadvantage and you have advantage on Dex saving throws until the start of your next turn, until you become incapacitated or your speed drops to 0.

entries.name: Escape
entries.description: Escape a grapple by winning a Str (Athletics) or Dex (Acrobatics) check vs. grappler’s Str (Athletics) check.

entries.name: Help
entries.description: Give an ally advantage on next ability check or attack roll vs. an opponent within 5 ft of you, if done before the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Hide
entries.description: Hide from those that can’t perceive you. Your Dex (Stealth) check is the DC for anybody’s Wis (Perception) check to discover you.

entries.name: Overrun
entries.description: Move through hostile’s space once by winning opposing Str (Athletics) check. Advantage if you are larger or disadvantage if you are smaller than the opponent.

entries.name: Ready
entries.description: Choose an action that you will take in response to a set trigger. Taking the action uses your reaction. Readying a spell requires concentration and expends the spell slot.

entries.name: Search
entries.description: Search for something, possibly with a Wis (Perception) or Int (Investigation) check.

entries.name: Tumble
entries.description: Move through hostile’s space once by winning opposing Dex (Acrobatics) check.

entries.name: Use object
entries.description: You can interact with an object once per turn for free. A second interaction and special cases take an action to complete (e.g. draw a second weapon, equip a shield, drink a potion, retrieve an item from a backpack).

entries.name: Move
entries.description: You can move your movement speed every turn. You can break up your movement between actions. You can switch back and forth between different types (e.g. from flying to walking), by subtracting the distance already moved from the new speed. You can freely move through a nonhostile’s space, and through a hostile’s space if it is two sizes larger or smaller than you. Another creature’s space counts as difficult terrain.

entries.name: Climb / swim
entries.description: May involve a Str (Athletics) check if the climb / swim is difficult.

entries.name: Crawl
entries.description: Crawl while prone (see conditions). Dropping prone costs no movement speed.

entries.name: Difficult terrain
entries.description: Moving through difficult terrain costs twice as much speed. Another creature’s space counts as difficult terrain.

entries.name: Jump
entries.description: After moving at least 10 feet on foot, you can jump your Str score in feet straight forward, or 3 + your Str modifier in feet up. The jump distance is halved when performing a standing jump.

entries.name: Stand up
entries.description: Standing up from being prone costs half your movement speed for this turn.
